notes.title: Update1021
notes.content:
[Update method] Continuous server update
[Update range] PC full server
[New Content]
1. New social module in the launcher (synchronized with mobile phone)
2. New friend message flashing prompt in the launcher
3. Removed the camera shake that comes with breathing mode
4. Support custom room name
5. Added three new nameplates unlocked by level
6. Optimized the performance of the scene resource shader
7. Brand new water resources

[VR optimization]
1. Added Index handle finger tracking
2. Added a switch for custom gestures (remote sensing by pressing the right handle vertically)
3. Removed the mouse lock of the game window in VR mode
4. Added the touch movement function of the HTC Vive handle
5. Separation of UI and PC in VR

If you have any questions, please join in our Discord server to contact us

notes.title: Release Note
notes.content:

Oasis-Oasis VR2020.07.28
Dear gamers, we plan to stop the server update on July 28. The estimated maintenance time is 2 hours.

Update method
Stop service update

Update range
Full server

New Content
1. The world page will show friends in the world
2. Added "Recent" tab to display recently visited rooms
3. Added the shortcut menu of the most commonly used models
4. Added phrase reply function
5. The upper limit of the level has been raised to level 30, and the experience mechanism has been modified
6. Brand new special effects nameplate (the old nameplate has been cancelled)
7. The points system is added, and "World: Casino" is updated to "World: Point Casino"
-Points compensation for old players: 
(1) Points compensation for existing level experience (compensation is 1.5 times the points obtained by the same experience after the update)
(2) Players who have uploaded World/Home/Avatar will reissue their points according to the new rules
(3) The old player nameplate will be reissued in the next version

VR optimization
1. Uncheck the ray when selecting the seat
2. Reduced the stroke area of ​​the seat in the official map
3. Optimized mouth shape performance
4. Fixed the bug of gesture realization
5. The game supports hot plugging of handles and body tracking devices
6. The position of the model during the whole-body tracking calibration is closer to the player's real position
7. A switch for body tracking has been added to the main menu

notes.title: Let’s start in Oasis
notes.content:
Hi guys, welcome to Oasis. As a virtual world game, you can customize abundant things even the world in it.

Here is the guide of Oasis:

1.Editor Tutorials


 Firstly you need a Unity Hub
 Open your Unity Hub.
  Our editors require Unity for V2019.2.x, you can copy this link （unityhub://2019.2.0f1/20c1667945cf ）to your browser， and click “open it in Unity Hub”.
Then Unity 2019.2.0f1 will be installed automatically.
To use Unity, you need to register first.
 After that, you can download Oasis editors on our official website
Or just click to download above editors:
Avatar Editor
World Editor


How to use them? Drag the editor to Unity and click import, log in with your Oasis account, then you can customize your avatars or worlds!

Here are the tutorial videos above:

Avatar Editor Tutorial
[previewyoutube=wrrzqff13ps;full][/previewyoutube]

World Editor Turorial
[previewyoutube=uH1T82ZGDto;full][/previewyoutube]

2.Developer Document

Oasis supports deeply designing the game through API. The document is prepared for you.

We’ll keep improving the document to ensure that you can do almost everything in Oasis!

3.Discord Community

Our Discord Community is the only official community for Oasis gamers now. You can find friends and turn to our staff to resolve the problems. 

Just click it to join us in Oasis Official Coummunity

notes.title: Welcome to Oasis!
notes.content:
Hi guys, welcome to Oasis, a brand new virtual world game with user-friendly editors!

About Oasis
Oasis is a cross-platform multi-player online virtual worlds which supports desktop and VR. It is a world in which anything could happen. There are not fixed rules instead of limitless possibilities. You may have a disco party with friends at a bar, or organizing a party game. You could also spell casting like harry potter, care your own farm and play with cats in the cafe...

Test and Feedback
You can visit our official website and download our avatar and world editors here. The editors requires Unity by version 2019.2x (the version cannot be higher or lower) and we will release the independent edition in June.

Now Oasis is at the status of Early Access. You can experience the game and give us any feedback or request on our Discord server.

Release Note
[olist]
 Steam VR selection supported while launching the game.
 Discord added in the main menu.
[/olist]

Coming Features
[olist]
 Independent editors
 More gaming methods
[/olist]
